method.mathematical_review: commutator/multiplicity reasoning; coefficient/cancellation/scale checks by reading and algebra

checks.grounding: The first term is muN*gR*sqrt(3/(4pi))*J; the alpha*J term is also retained at first surface-deformation order. The source zero is explicitly restricted to the deformation-independent zeroth-order piece.
checks.retained_boundary: No extension of this zero to the complete first-order M1 operator.

checks.grounding: For exact energy eigenstates, <f|[H,Jq]|i>=(Ef-Ei)<f|Jq|i>. With rotationally invariant H and Ef!=Ei the generator matrix element is zero. The section attributes this derivation to the task.
checks.retained_boundary: External fields or a nonconserved/nonconstant gyromagnetic operator require a different calculation.

source_locators: new section representation argument, task derivation
checks.grounding: The stated identity-on-internal-space representation gives delta_JfJi*delta_nufnui*sqrt(Ji(Ji+1)(2Ji+1)). J+/- within one spin multiplet changes M and can be nonzero; source line120 explicitly preserves that exception.
checks.retained_boundary: Zero means distinct energy/internal multiplets, not every matrix entry off the M diagonal. Degenerate orthogonal internal copies are still distinct from M substates.

checks.grounding: Eq2.3c has separate orbital/spin weights. A rank1 tensor can carry off-diagonal multiplicity factors; sigma_x internal tensor Jq is a mathematical example. Its physical realization is not asserted.
checks.retained_boundary: Triangle/parity permission does not establish measured M1 strength or hindrance.

source_locators: printed128/PDF10 last paragraph generator-only M1 cancellation
checks.grounding: Operator fluctuation and state mixing arise from the same small-amplitude expansion parameter. Eq3.24 has both at first amplitude order. In the beta same-J treatment, the M0 combination can cancel; for M0 proportional J the M1 band-mixing term vanishes. The canonical text states order, not that all such terms are nonzero.
checks.retained_boundary: A term may have a zero coefficient without changing its order assignment. This is not a theorem of nonzero transitions for all J/K or all models.

source_locators: printed126/PDF8 Eqs3.18–3.23: phonon basis, gamma0=0, good K
printed129/PDF11 discussion of closed shells and anharmonicity
checks.grounding: The n1-to-n0 and n0-to-n0 statements are source-model counting under the given phonon/small-fluctuation perturbation. Near-axial K structure and the spin/band geometry determine which reduced moments occur. LKH82-9 and the section identify the model/operator context.
checks.retained_boundary: Do not export these formulas unchanged to strongly anharmonic, quasiparticle, high-spin or arbitrary K-mixed states.

checks.grounding: The source states that the first g+ derivative vanishes in 152Sm while small nonzero M1 moments come from second and higher terms; it expressly says this is not known to be general. Both qualifications are preserved.
checks.retained_boundary: This is not proof that a quadratic displacement has a nonzero harmonic <0|x^2|1> element.

checks.grounding: Eq3.31 displays muN, whereas reported slope units are n.m. and n.m./rad. Gnu=muN*gnu is a consistent dimensionful convention; beta is dimensionless and gamma is in rad.
checks.retained_boundary: Do not multiply a numerical slope already reported in n.m. by muN a second time.

source_locators: printed129/PDF11 footnote3 attached to the g-minus M1 expression
checks.grounding: The footnote says the angular-momentum part can change K by one and the D-function part by one additional unit, so this M1 operator can connect DeltaK2. The canonical statement is restricted to this operator/wave-function approximation.
checks.retained_boundary: It does not invalidate all strict-K selection rules for independently specified axial states and intrinsic tensors, or prove all DeltaK2 M1 transitions are unhindered.

checks.grounding: The source explicitly projects the microscopic 3A-dimensional problem into a five-dimensional collective quadrupole Hamiltonian after retaining time derivatives through second order. Rot-vib and K mixing are treated exactly within that space; the collective equation is solved numerically.
checks.retained_boundary: Full-nucleus exactness, exact arbitrary quasiparticle coupling and model-independent currents are not claimed.

checks.topic: PPQ approximation list, spin and Pauli
source_locators: printed131/PDF13 list(a)–(d) and SecIII.D.3 opening paragraph
checks.grounding: PPQ interaction, oscillator radial functions, neglected Coriolis antipairing/pairing reduction and direct two-or-more-quasiparticle coupling match the original list. The source discussion gives approximately +/-15% spin contributions, and cautions about nonorthogonality/Pauli violations in naive collective/few-nucleon combinations.
checks.retained_boundary: The +/-15% is not a universal correction factor; PPQ, dynamic-deformation and shell/core treatments retain distinct assumptions.

checks.grounding: delta^2 is the E2/M1 photon-rate ratio. The two explicitly synthetic shared-unit examples both have delta100 and E2 rates differing by10000. Extra gamma components leave delta pairwise; no absolute E2 strength or total E2 fraction is inferred.
checks.retained_boundary: Signed delta still carries convention-dependent relative-sign information, preserved in LKH82-1. M1=0 has no ordinary finite reference ratio; both components zero gives0/0.

checks.topic: DF cancellation, charge and mass exponent
checks.grounding: The E2/M1 B-ratio is (7/80)*(Ze*R0^2/(gR*muN))^2; multiplying by3q^2/100 gives the section formula. Substituting R0 proportional A^(1/3) and gR=Z/A gives amplitude proportional A^(5/3), matching source3.56e-3*Eg[MeV]. Charge e is retained.
checks.retained_boundary: The common beta0^2*sin^2(3gamma0)/(9-8sin^2(3gamma0)) factor is cancelable only off its zero set. On the zero set, both retained rates vanish and the reduced ratio is a limit.

checks.grounding: The caption says the experimental gamma-ray energy in column3 has been used for all the theory values. The canonical statement correctly calls the model comparison conditional and the energy a shared input.
checks.retained_boundary: This comparison does not separately validate predicted excitation/gamma energies.

checks.grounding: The source says IBM agrees better with magnitudes and PPQ with signs;8 shared cases have IBM3 and PPQ1 wrong signs; larger PPQ comparison has8/46 wrong signs and W disagreement. The new section defers to the correctly bounded LKH82-2.
checks.retained_boundary: These are author-reported counts from heterogeneous compiled data, not a fresh row-by-row certification or universal model ranking.

checks.topic: Missing degrees of freedom and observable completeness
source_locators: printed183/PDF65 giant-monopole/seniority discussion and closing Tl example
printed119/PDF1 low-order approximation, existing extracted text
checks.grounding: The source retains model-space/symmetry-breaking limitations and asks for gamma mixing-ratio measurement when large K conversion can still fit M1. The canonical transfer list appropriately requires common states/current, absolute rates, non-gamma inventory and response checks. Long-wave/rank factors alone do not make every higher allowed component identically zero.
checks.retained_boundary: No quantitative M3/E4 upper bound or physical realization of the free-amplitude seeds was supplied by this review.
